title: hunterXhunter
tagline: Git on walrus the most scalable application infrastructure present
description: The concept of reuseing and recycleying of projects have been a really common, Minute changes of the codebase dosnt carry innovation nor nowalty but they monopolize the bounties and there is no evidence to prove it because it can be erased easily so we built a HunterxHunter that can maintain your repoitories which also prevents time travelling of code. Though this maintainance and guidance of codebase is truely immutable.
how_its_made: Shell scripts automate wallet initialization and blob creation, bridging the gap between blockchain commands and our backend. This setup prevents tampering or "time traveling" in code history, ensuring true immutability and transparency. Then through those use to provide .git like functionality but in walrus it is .walrus returning a .json file. This flow emphasises the implementation of using github. The commands are also walrus-list, walrus-push and walrus-pull.
